items.title: GPT-4, GPT - 5 / OpenAI
items.text: A large multimodal language model capable of understanding and generating text and images. It offers improved reasoning, context handling (up to 128k tokens). It is widely used for chatbots, coding assistance, content creation, and enterprise applications. Can be easily integrated into existing workflows to power reasoning, summarization, and natural communication.

items.title: Claude 3.5 family / Anthropic
items.text: These models provide their strong reasoning, long context handling (over 200k tokens), and a focus on safety and helpfulness through Anthropic’s “Constitutional AI” approach. Claude 3.5 models are widely used in enterprise, legal, and research applications, offering robust performance in summarization, analysis, and complex problem-solving.

items.title: LLaMA 4 / Meta AI
items.text: Built as an open-weight large language model, LLaMA 4 is designed for high efficiency, scalability, and strong performance in both text and multimodal tasks. It supports long context windows (128k+ tokens) and is widely used in research, enterprise, and custom AI deployments due to its accessibility and flexibility. LLaMA 4 is notable for its open licensing, enabling broad adoption and innovation in the AI community.

items.title: Gemini / Google
items.text: Designed as a family of advanced multimodal AI models, Gemini is capable of understanding and generating text, images, audio, and video. Gemini excels in long-context reasoning (up to 1 million tokens in its Ultra version) and integrates deeply with Google’s ecosystem, making it suitable for search, productivity, and creative applications. It is available through Google Cloud and various Google products.

items.title: DeepSeek
items.text: As an open-weight large language model, DeepSeek is designed for high efficiency and strong performance in both text and code tasks. It supports long context windows (128k+ tokens) and is notable for its accessibility to researchers and developers. DeepSeek is widely used for research, coding assistance, and general-purpose AI applications, offering a balance of capability and openness.

items.title: Llama 4 / Meta
items.text: With its open-weight foundation, LLaMA 4 is designed for high efficiency, scalability, and strong performance in both text and multimodal tasks. It supports long context windows (128k+ tokens) and is widely adopted for research, enterprise, and custom AI solutions due to its open licensing and flexibility.
